answers.questionTitle: What makes us compatible?
answers.actualPdfAnswer: This match shares a similar need for care: you value being heard before someone offers a solution; your partner values listening as well as practical help. This is common ground, but both of you can end up waiting for the other to provide it.
answers.deductionRationale: Both partners’ care needs are named, but the ending remains broad and partly repeats the needs.
